questions.stem: A 17-year-old boy presents with a 3-day history of low-grade fever, malaise, and pain in front of the right ear. On examination, there is a soft, tender swelling of the right parotid region. The swelling is warm and causes difficulty chewing. The patient has not received the MMR vaccine. He denies any discharge from the ear or dental issues. Serum amylase is elevated. Which of the following statements regarding this condition is most accurate?
questions.stemHtml: A 17-year-old boy presents with a 3-day history of low-grade fever, malaise, and pain in front of the right ear. On examination, there is a soft, tender swelling of the right parotid region. The swelling is warm and causes difficulty chewing. The patient has not received the MMR vaccine. He denies any discharge from the ear or dental issues. Serum amylase is elevated. Which of the following statements regarding this condition is most accurate?

options.label: A
options.text: Mumps is diagnosed by imaging and is treated with intravenous antivirals

options.label: B
options.text: Parotid swelling due to mumps usually resolves in 1 week with supportive care

options.label: C
options.text: Orchitis is the most common complication in females and often results in infertility

options.label: D
options.text: Mumps immunoglobulin is highly effective for post-exposure prophylaxis
